subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-13 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's call to read 'high culture' through affinity-dynamics rather than applied empiricism: 'the individual brilliance that has underlined how given culture groups attain high culture … has more to do with the realness of affinity dynamics than any notion of superiority.' (R)PRI-INFO (the reality of principle information) is crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics): the question is what principle-information produces in its real instantiation when crossed with information-dynamics. The (R) prefix on the subject is load-bearing — Braxton commits here that principle-information *actually* exists across cultures, not merely conceptually. TH-CONT (theoretical continuance) feeds upward from below into the subject. INFO-PROJ (information projection) anchors the upper-right output. ATTN (attention) sits centrally between the two upstreams from PRI-INFO and PROJ-DY. ACT-TR (actual transformation) and AFI (affinity insight) cluster on the right output chain. RT-DY (reality dynamics) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) form the lower-left upstream chain. CUL-TR-S (cultural transfer source) anchors the lower-right margin. Structural argument: principle-information-as-real crossed with information-dynamics is mediated through attention as central hub. The productive outputs (actual-transformation, affinity-insight, cultural-transfer-source) are sustained only through doubled upstreams — theoretical-continuance and reality-dynamics on one side, projectional-dynamics on the other.
